$comment: GENERATED by scripts/generate-convergence-docs.ts. The machine-readable list of every canonical call a client may make. Diff your own call sites against this. Only MOUNTED endpoints appear: a planned entry is documentation, and generating a typed client from one would ship calls to a 404.
$version: contractSha256 is the sha256 of the OpenAPI document this API serves, and every /api/v1 response carries the same value in the x-contract-sha256 header. Compare the two to find out whether this pinned copy is stale. It is NOT a hash of this file.
$requestBody: requiredBody / allowedBody / additionalBodyAllowed are DERIVED from the same SCHEMAS map the OpenAPI document is rendered from, so the two cannot disagree. All three are null when an operation declares no request body — null and [] mean different things, and an empty allow-list would read as "no field is permitted". bodyEnforcement says how the contract is enforced: no middleware validates a request body against these schemas, so each handler enforces its own preconditions. Read requiredBody as "the handler refuses without this", not as "a validator rejects this".
